name: Guest_Gear Digital Flora Gear by JustNU ported to 3.7.*
description_html:
This is the gear from the original mod from JustNU. All credit for retextures go to JustNU. I simply moved some code around.

includes

Beta 2 Pack
Attack 2 Pack
ARS CPC Mod 2 Rig
ANA M1 Rig
zhuk6 Armored Vest
LSZH 2dtm Helmet Cover and Aventail (not pictured)

- Config option to disable/enable each item (MAKE SURE YOU DO NOT HAVE IT IN YOUR INVENTORY BEFORE DISABLING ONE OF THEM).

- Add to traders (optional, true by default).

- Add to bots (optional, true by default).

- Adjusted following quests (Optional, true by default):

1) The survivalist path. Unprotected, but dangerous.

2) Swift one.
